name: Wassamu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Wassamu town emblem in navy: a ring open at the top with a letter V-shaped device above.
history: Municipal flag of Wassamu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 24 August 1965.

features.role: Wassamu town emblem — a ring open at the top with a letter V-shaped device above
